attributes.board_name: North Carolina Social Work Certification and Licensure Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Social work-related academic courses, agency staff development, seminars, workshops and conferences (no Board pre-approval); distance learning only if preapproved by ASWB (ACE) or NASW/NASW-NC; 1 academic course hour = 15 contact hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: If the certificate/license period is less than a full two years, 30 contact hours (at least 4 in ethics). LCSWA applying for LCSW early: pro-rated hours per the Board's position statement.
rules.audit_note: Renewal Affidavit lists all CE taken; certificates not attached but must be produced if audited (can be selected immediately at online renewal).

topics.who: All levels: ethics related to social work practice and ethical decision-making

rules.notes: Distance learning max 20 hours (one-half); live synchronous webinars count as face-to-face. Self-care max 6 hours; presenting max 5 hours. Renewal fee $150 is for LCSW/CSWM ($140 LCSWA, $90 CMSW, $70 CSW). Cycle runs from date of issue/last renewal.
